bel_home_mairead.text: Come on in, the kettle is on. In Belfast, 'a wee while' can mean anywhere from five minutes to a week.
'Scundered' means fed up or embarrassed, usually both. 'Catch yourself on' means stop being silly. I say both every day.

then.text: That is all I have, I am afraid. Off you go, and mind how you go.

else.text: Mind the chipgulls down at the Docks. They have a system, and the system is you.
Ach, come in. You'll have a farl? You will.
Soda bread on a griddle, cut in quarters. A bit of wild garlic through it if you're fancy. And you are fancy, I can see.
Pop in whenever you've got the makings. You can use my kitchen.
